_comment: CAPTURED, not hand-written. The SDK-side half of durable chat: the exact sequence of ChatClientPersistence calls the real ChatClient issues while replaying a real /api/ask answer. The stream it replays was itself captured live (POST /api/ask, 318 TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT deltas). This exists to justify — and keep justifying — the debounce in server-persistence.ts: the SDK persists on every message change and ChatPersistor.runOperation chains rather than coalesces, so an un-debounced server adapter issues one write per token. If a future SDK starts coalescing, the guard test on this fixture goes red and the debounce can be revisited. Re-capture after any SDK bump.
